title: Values of literal vertices
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers with $k\le n$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and take $i<n$ and $b\in\{0,1\}$. The value at vertex $i$ if $b$ is true, and at vertex $n+i$ if $b$ is false, equals true exactly when the input bit $x_i$ equals $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$-bit inputs
